provenance: Planning-owned reconciliation from the current BUG-005 spec, design, and Scope 01. Existing evidence links are preserved, no product test is re-executed, and no certification or human-acceptance claim is made. The repaired contract has no shipped-page caller, so browser rows remain supplemental non-movement coverage only.

scenarios.title: A domain whose every event has aged out yields no signal

gherkin.given: a workspace whose only equity-research event occurred 190.92 days ago under a declared 56-day evidence window
gherkin.when: rlportfolio.deriveInterestSignals evaluates that workspace at the reference instant
gherkin.then: the public function returns an ok envelope without an equity-research signal and does not throw

obligations.requiredProof: A production public-function assertion transforms the stale-only workspace into an ok envelope with the stale domain absent.
Named stale-only and future-dated-only negative paths return honest omission with no throw or plausible default.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Reinstating pre-filter bucket creation must make the same stale-only input throw RangeError instead of returning the envelope.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-005: a domain whose every eligible event has aged out yields no signal instead of throwing

expectedAssertions: the result is an ok envelope

scenarios.title: A stale domain does not suppress a fresh sibling

gherkin.given: one stale-only domain and one domain with in-window evidence in the same workspace
gherkin.then: the stale domain is absent and the fresh domain retains its isolated evidenceScore and relevanceBand

obligations.requiredProof: A production public-function assertion compares the fresh signal from the mixed workspace with the same domain derived in isolation while proving the stale sibling is absent.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Reinstating pre-filter bucket creation must make the mixed derivation throw before the fresh sibling can be returned.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-005: a stale domain must not suppress the fresh domains beside it

expectedAssertions: the mixed derivation returns an ok envelope
the fresh signal matches its isolated score and relevance band

scenarios.title: Reinstating pre-filter bucket creation reproduces the RangeError

gherkin.given: module source whose domain bucket is created before the age filter
gherkin.when: the stale-only fixture is derived against that source
gherkin.then: the faithful mutant throws RangeError while the shipped ordering returns an envelope

obligations.requiredProof: The carrier invokes the shipped and faithfully mutated public function on controlled fixtures and distinguishes their transformed outcomes.
The named superseded ordering throws RangeError on stale-only input after a fresh-only control proves the mutant remains executable.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Removing the pre-filter mutation or allowing the mutant stale-only call to return must fail the RangeError assertion.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-005: reinstating the superseded pre-filter bucket creation turns the stale-domain assertion red

expectedAssertions: the mutant still handles fresh-only input
the mutant throws RangeError for stale-only input
the shipped function returns an envelope for the same stale-only input

gherkin.given: a domain with one in-window event and a declared floor of two distinct completions
gherkin.then: the domain is emitted with floorSatisfied false and relevanceBand insufficient-evidence

obligations.requiredProof: A production public-function assertion proves in-window evidence below the floor remains in the returned signal array with the specified fields.
The insufficient-evidence state is represented explicitly rather than omitted or replaced by a plausible default.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Dropping every below-floor domain must fail the expected emitted signal and insufficient-evidence assertions.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-005: in-window evidence below the floor is still emitted, so the fix widened nothing

scenarios.title: Both derivations deny live relevance to a stale domain

gherkin.given: the same stale-only workspace and declared evidence policy
gherkin.when: rlportfolio and rlportfoliobrief each derive interest signals
gherkin.then: rlportfolio omits the stale domain while rlportfoliobrief reports zero score no supporting occurrences and an unsatisfied floor

obligations.requiredProof: One carrier invokes both production public functions with the same stale evidence and asserts each contract's distinct zero-relevance form.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Emitting live relevance from either derivation for the stale domain must fail the omission or zero-support assertions.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-005: rlportfolio and rlportfoliobrief agree that a stale domain carries zero live relevance

expectedAssertions: rlportfoliobrief reports no supporting occurrences and an unsatisfied floor
